title: Add database schema MVP

context.summary: Create the Drizzle schema and initial SQL migration for the MVP database model.
context.background: TASK-3 established the Docker Compose Postgres service. TASK-4 defines canonical PostgreSQL business-state tables before API and worker implementation.

in: Create Drizzle PostgreSQL schema definitions in packages/db.
Create the initial SQL migration for MVP tables, enums, constraints and indexes.
Add Drizzle Kit configuration for the db package.
Add database schema validation to repository checks.
Update database and memory model documentation.
out: Run migrations against a live database.
Implement auth token issuance or hashing.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: packages/db defines Drizzle schema for projects, access tokens, peers, sessions, messages, documents, attachments, chunks, memory claims and processing jobs.
Token project scopes and session peer membership are represented without breaking multi-project token support.
Schema uses enums for MVP statuses and domain type fields.
Schema stores SourceSnapshot, SourceRef and metadata as jsonb where the PRD calls for extensible structures.
Initial SQL migration creates all MVP tables, enums, constraints and foreign-key indexes.
Repository checks include database schema validation.
Documentation describes the canonical schema and migration location.
No API, worker, MCP, CLI or Hermes runtime behavior is implemented.

manual_checks: Confirm all MVP tables from the PRD are present.
Confirm schema and migration include no runtime API, worker or adapter behavior.

risks: The migration is not applied in this task because no live database migration runner exists yet.
Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so dependency installation and real Drizzle/TypeScript execution may need to wait until pnpm is installed.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
